top_signals.title: Airtel Money to Debut After London’s Biggest IPO in Five Years
top_signals.summary: Mobile payments firm Airtel Money is set to start trading on the London Stock Exchange later on Friday, a listing that may mark the largest initial public offering for the bourse in five years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
